messages.text: Hello! So, funny story: I ordered these pillow covers thinking they'd match my sofa, and my cat immediately decided one of them was her new bed. Anyway, I sent the pillow cover back, the one that didn't work. Could you refund it? Also, is it normal that colours look different in person?

messages.text:
Happy to help! Which pillow cover would you like refunded—the mustard or the teal? The shop’s records show both were received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

Colours can look different in person because of lighting and screen settings. The refund policy doesn’t address colour accuracy, but I can offer a staff member if you’d like help with that (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).
